title: The 2 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers Under $30
h1: The 2 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers Under $30
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for panini presses and sandwich makers under $30, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at panini presses and sandwich makers under $30 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Proctor Silex Deluxe Hot Sandwich Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits 2 sandwiches at once, PFAS-free ceramic nonstick plates, 700W element.
strengths: Ceramic nonstick plates hold up well and clean easily for the price point
Fast preheat, ready to cook within a couple minutes of plugging in
limitations: Fixed clamshell gap, no floating hinge for thick sandwiches
One heat setting, no temperature dial
Plates aren't removable for a deep clean

products.name: DASH Mini Maker Portable Grill Machine and Panini Press
strengths: Easy to store in a drawer
limitations: Makes one item at a time
